title: Odyssey Sports Tournament 2027
objectives: Create networking opportunities with industry and alumni
resources: Lab access, projectors, certificates and volunteer coordination
risks: Low turnout due to overlapping academic schedules

claims.claim_text: We anticipate around 203 attendees for this first-of-its-kind Sports Tournament for our club.
The requested budget of INR 35,000 is realistic and sufficient for this Sports Tournament.
Our previous events were delivered on budget and received excellent participant feedback.
This event complies with all applicable university policies and approval requirements.
This event will become a flagship tradition for the university.
